duration a Clean Cuts stack lasts before expiring

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks consume a Clean Cuts stack to fire an empowered attack that deals the attack's normal damage to the primary target and additional physical damage to other enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Xayah's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} are empowered to each consume a stack {{tip|on-attack}} to instead shoot a {{as|Feather|buzzword}} that deals the triggering {{as|attack's damage}} to the primary target and {{as|{{pp|key=%|35 to 55 for 3|1 to 13}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to other enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: The secondary target damage can critically strike (for reduced crit damage) if the triggering attack crits.
mechanics.quote: The secondary target damage can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Xayah|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage if the triggering attack does.

mechanics.claim: The primary-target hit copies all properties of the basic attack (can trigger on-hit effects, can miss/be blinded) and applies lifesteal.
mechanics.quote: This is the damage to the primary target, and copies all properties of the basic attack.

mechanics.claim: The pass-through (secondary target) damage does not trigger on-hit effects and does not apply lifesteal by default, and cannot miss.
Clean Cuts feathers still spawn even if the empowering basic attack is blocked.
mechanics.quote: ''Clean Cut's'' feathers will spawn even if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}}.
